fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 14 lineHeight: 1.6 color: "#3E4845" align: - left - top - elementId: ft-mark elementType: image bounds: - 56 - 505 - 16 - 16 src: "media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png" sourceName: huandeng.png fit: mode: contain - elementId: ft-label elementType: text bounds: - 78 - 505 - 600 - 16 content: text: HUANDENG / 故事先行：一页从头到尾 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 11 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - middle - elementId: ft-pos elementType: text bounds: - 824 - 505 - 80 - 16 content: text: "0" fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 11 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - right - middle field: main-position notes: 打磨任何一页之前，我会先把整份稿子当故事读一遍。大纲视图按章节列出每一页的标题、故事摘要和页面短码，我能看出论证是否成立。浏览视图用缩略图显示同样的页面，看密度和节奏。章节把讲述分成几部分，每章从一个稳定的首页开始，到下一章为止。
